data.rule: pooled: every profiled team's selected hands

bluff.note: bluff share = part of the bet/raise frequency taken from the bottom of the strength range (postflop) or from just below the calling range (preflop 3-bets); estimated from showdowns, so biased low (bluffs that get folds are never shown)

spot_keys.preflop: pf|<ctx>|<group>. group = position group of the actor (EP = UTG/UTG+1/UTG+2, MP = MP/HJ, CO, BTN, SB, BB) for ctx unopened/limped/vs_open, jammer type tight/wild for vs_jam/vs_jam_inv, 'all' otherwise.

pf ctx.unopened: no voluntary money yet (only blinds): F fold, P limp/complete, R open-raise, J open-jam
pf ctx.limped: no raise yet, >= 1 limper (BB option included): F, P over-limp (BB: check), R iso-raise, J
pf ctx.vs_open: exactly one raise, actor has not put voluntary money in (blinds count as not): F, P call, R 3-bet, J 3-bet all-in
pf ctx.limper_vs_raise: actor limped, now faces one raise: F, P, R, J
pf ctx.opener_vs_3bet: actor made the first raise and now faces exactly one re-raise: F, P, R 4-bet, J
pf ctx.cold_vs_3bet: >= 2 raises, actor has not acted voluntarily: F, P, R, J
pf ctx.caller_vs_3bet: >= 2 raises, actor limped/called before but never raised: F, P, R, J
pf ctx.raiser_vs_4bet: actor raised before and faces another raise (3-bettor vs 4-bet, opener vs 5-bet, ...): F, P, R, J
pf ctx.vs_jam: pf|vs_jam|<tight|wild>: facing a jam (current high bet >= 1000 = 50bb, overrides the contexts above), actor has no voluntary money in: F, P call. tight/wild = the last jammer's preflop jam rate (hands with a jam / hands) at the table is < / >= 5% (logs: over the whole round; clone: running estimate (jams + 0.3) / (hands + 20))
pf ctx.vs_jam_inv: pf|vs_jam_inv|<tight|wild>: facing a jam after having limped/called/raised: F, P

spot_keys.jam: J = a preflop raise that is all-in or to >= 1000 chips (50bb)
spot_keys.postflop: <street>|<ctx>|<hu|mw>[|<bucket>]; hu = exactly 2 players not folded at the decision

post ctx (nothing to call).agg: actor was the aggressor of the previous street (flop: last preflop raiser) - c-bet/barrel
post ctx (nothing to call).donk: previous-street aggressor still in and yet to act on this street - donk bet
post ctx (nothing to call).probe: previous-street aggressor already checked this street
post ctx (nothing to call).noagg: no previous-street aggressor (limped pot, street checked through, aggressor folded)

post ctx (facing).vs_bet: facing exactly one bet, first action on the street: F, C, R
post ctx (facing).xr: facing exactly one bet after having checked this street: F, C, R (R = check-raise)
post ctx (facing).vs_raise_agg: <street>|vs_raise_agg: facing a raise after having bet/raised this street
post ctx (facing).vs_raise_cold: <street>|vs_raise_cold: facing a bet and >= 1 raise without having bet this street

spot_keys.bucket: size of the bet being faced = the bettor's bet / pot before the bet (pot includes all earlier streets): b1 <= 0.35, b2 <= 0.55, b3 <= 0.8, b4 <= 1.1, b5 > 1.1

definitions.cell: n = decisions, counts = raw action counts, p = smoothed probabilities used by the clone (p = (counts + 12*prior)/(n + 12); prior = field's p for the same spot, tilted by the team's own coarse tendency over groups/sizes/hu-mw), sizes = histogram used for raise/bet sizes
definitions.sizes: preflop unopened/limped: raise-to in bb (0.1bb bins); other preflop raises: raise-to / current high bet ('x', 0.1 bins); postflop: rfrac = (raise_to - high_bet) / (pot + to_call) in 0.05 bins, 'allin' when the bet/raise left the stack at 0; preflop jams are excluded (they are action J)
definitions.strength: preflop: hand percentile in the clone's 169-class order (0 = aces, 1 = worst). postflop: s = percentile of the made hand among all two-card holdings on the board (ties half, 1 = nuts) plus a draw bonus on flop/turn (clone.strength)
definitions.showdown: for hands the team showed down: pf|<line> histogram of preflop percentile (deciles d0 best..d9), <street>|<act> histogram of strength deciles at the street where the act (last action of the street: bet/raise/call/check) was taken (d9 strongest); weak = s < 0.35
definitions.summary: vpip/pfr per hand excluding BB walks; three_bet = (R+J)/n over vs_open; fold_to_3bet = F/n over opener_vs_3bet; open_<grp> = (R+J)/n over unopened; cbet_flop = B/n over flop|agg; fold_vs_<street>_<bucket> = F/n over vs_bet+xr; agg_<street> = (B+R)/all decisions on the street; wtsd = showdowns / hands that saw the flop; wsd = showdowns won / showdowns; allin_pf / allin_post = hands with an all-in action on that phase / hands

fitted.note: cdf[key].q = strength quantiles at u = 0, 1/20, ..., 1 of the clone's own decisions in that spot under the previous policy (calibrate.py)
